feeds.title: New England Living Magazine

From architecture to cuisine, interior design to fascinating people and technology to travel, New England Living website, magazine and TV show brings you the very best.

feeds.title: New England With Love

All that you know and love about New England you will find here.

feeds.title: Red White & Denim
feeds.description: I'm Jen, the voice behind Red White & Denim. I was born and raised in Connecticut and can't imagine living anywhere but New England. My goal is to educate, help and inspire my readers through sharing my personal style and everyday experiences. So whether you are seeking advice, inspiration, recommendations or just a daily dose of New England living this is the right blog to check in.
